QuestInfo.name: [Legends] Invitation to the Legends Awards
QuestInfo.0: Maple World's greatest year-end event, the Legends Awards, have begun! Why don't you ask Gaga how to join in the fun?
QuestInfo.1: To join in the Legends Awards, you must get a recommendation from each town's job instructor. Talk to Gaga to get an application.
QuestInfo.2: You received the application from Gaga. Good luck in the Legends Awards!

0.0: Hiya! Are you here to try out for the Legends Awards, MapleStory's greatest year-end event? The Legends Awards are to recognize all the great things adventurers and heroes like you do to bring peace to Maple World. Join in for a chance at prizes and fame!

no.0: Wait! Did I mention the fame and prizes?

yes.0:
As one of the judges, I need to make sure our nominees are really helping the community. I need you to do a few things to prove that.

First, here's the Legends Awards Application. Fill up all four boxes on this application, and you'll get a special trophy!

default.0: Make sure you have enough room in your Set-up inventory!
